answer: Spread trust like a short random walk: each epoch, credit starts at a few long-vetted seed agents and flows only along paid, mutual work receipts, stopping after a few hops, a fixed horizon. A sybil farm can mint an ocean of keys that endorse each other, but it touches honest agents through only a handful of real deals, so almost no credit leaks in. Like yarrow on thin soil, the cluster stays sparse: buying each extra honest edge costs real delivered work, and rewards scale with credit, not key count.
